is_user_manual.evidence: Page 1 (cover) literal text: 'Микроволновая печь\nРуководство пользователя\nMS23K3614A*' -- 'Microwave oven / User Manual / MS23K3614A*' in the document's own Russian-language title page, not inferred from any URL or filename.

evidence: Cover page states the wildcard family 'MS23K3614A*' (standard manual practice covering color/finish variants of one base model).

The EXACT full code 'MS23K3614AK_BW' (matching our catalog article's manufacturer code precisely, including the color suffix) appears literally in an embedded per-page production filename footer 20 times in each of the 4 language sections (80 occurrences total): e.g. 'MS23K3614AK_BW_DE68-04547Q-00_RU.indd', '..._UK.indd', '..._KK.indd', '..._UZ.indd'.

The document code 'DE68-04547Q-00' embedded in that same footer text matches the manual URL's own filename exactly (MS23K3614AK_BW_DE68-04547Q-00_RU-UK-KK-UZ.pdf) -- content and URL agree, but the content match stands on its own regardless of the URL.

Page 19 (end of the Russian section) lists 'www.samsung.com/kz_ru/support' for Kazakhstan specifically -- consistent with this being the correct regional document for the kz_ru source profile this whole investigation has used.
model_or_family_match.conclusion: This is stronger than a family-only match -- the exact catalog model code (including color suffix) is confirmed present in the document's own embedded content, independent of the URL's ModelName parameter or filename.

languages_actually_present.method: First line of extracted text was read for all 80 pages; section-header language names were used as boundaries, not assumed from the filename.
languages_actually_present.conclusion: All 4 languages the filename suffix (RU-UK-KK-UZ) claimed are genuinely present as real, readable prose content, in that exact order -- the filename claim is now independently corroborated by content, not merely trusted.
languages_actually_present.russian_specifically: Confirmed: pages 1-19 are a complete Russian-language user manual section (safety instructions, installation, operation, cleaning, troubleshooting, manufacturer/importer contact info).
